description:
Job description

LOCALIZA&CO
Estar em constante evolução nos trouxe até aqui. Ao lado de talentos e habilidades múltiplas nos conectamos em busca da nossa motivação: construir o futuro da mobilidade sustentável. É por meio da valorização da individualidade de cada um que impulsionamos o nosso movimento para conquistar resultados extraordinários, desenvolver nossas operações e criar soluções para os nossos clientes.

Somos apaixonados por nossa história, por nossas ideias e pela capacidade de realizá-las.

Sabemos que juntos, todos vamos mais longe. É assim que conectamos a Localiza&Co com o futuro.

O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ FAZER COMO TÉCNICO DE OPERAÇÕES

  1. Contribuir para a qualidade da frota nas filiais e zelar pelo bom funcionamento da mesma, visando a satisfação dos clientes por meio da elevada qualidade dos carros disponíveis para o aluguel e reduzir custo e improdutividade da filial;

  3. Realizar a auditoria diária dos carros, mediante controle dos carros em sistema, lançando os dados, conferindo as informações e registrando as situações de quilometragem improdutiva (RKI);
  4. Realizar o inventário da frota, por meio da contagem física dos carros, confrontando com relatórios sistêmicos, apontando e corrigindo inconsistências.

O QUE PRECISAMOS

  1. CNH categoria B há, no mínimo, 2 anos
  2. Ensino Médio completo
  3. Conhecimento em mecânica de veículos
  4. Capacidade de negociação com fornecedores

BENEFÍCIOS

  1. Uniforme
  2. Participação nos Lucros
  3. Vale Alimentação
  4. Vale Refeição
  5. Convênio Médico
  6. Convênio Odontológico

  8. Previdência Privada
  9. Auxílio Creche

  11. Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza
  12. Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento

QUAL SERÁ A JORNADA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO?

  1. Cadastro

description:
Como o time GENERATIVE AI constrói a Loft:

A missão do time de AI Generativa é focar no alto crescimento, construindo o futuro da Loft usando LLMs e modelos multimodais. O time foca em construir novos produtos para potencializar o negócio da Loft (como o Simulador de Financiamento no Whatsapp ), desenvolvendo a visão de GenAI da companhia e suportando outros times na utilização dessa tecnologia.

Essa posição é chave para o futuro da Loft, com um potencial muito alto de crescimento. Procuramos uma pessoa que tenha sangue no olho para tirar aplicações de GenAI de alto impacto do papel e capturar esse potencial. Além disso, procuramos uma pessoa empreendedora para pensar o futuro da Loft com GenAI, respondendo à pergunta: "Se a Loft fosse fundada hoje, como seria diferente?".

Buscamos pessoas que gostam de desafios, entregam resultados em time, de forma consistente, fazem a coisa certa e enxergam boas oportunidades de desenvolvimento em ambientes acelerados e cheios de mudanças, como é o nosso.

Os desafios que você vai encontrar:

  1. Definir o roadmap de GenAI em conjunto com pares de produto, design e negócio;
  2. Participar na construção da visão de AI da Loft;
  3. Recrutar e desenvolver a equipe para suportar o crescimento do escopo de GenAI;
  4. Suportar outros times da Loft na utilização de GenAI;
  5. Liderar cientistas de dados e engenheiros no escopo de 1 a 2 squads.

O que você precisa para virar a chave?

  1. Forte habilidade e experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  2. Track record demonstrado em usar tecnologia para causar impacto no negócio;
  3. Experiência técnica em GenAI, conhecimento de design patterns (routing, orchestrator/workers, etc.) e modelos/APIs (OpenAI, Vertex/Gemini, Anthropic, modelos open source);
  4. Experiências prévias em ciência de dados e/ou engenharia de software;
  5. Experiência em trabalhar com metodologias ágeis e ter mindset de start-up;
  6. Forte habilidade de comunicação.

title: Sr. Tax Analyst - ICMS, ICMS-ST
description:
Are you ready to take on complex tax challenges at a global leader in technology, commerce, and innovation?
We're hiring a Senior Tax Analyst! If you're looking for a new opportunity, check out this open role on our Tax Compliance team in Brazil.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Providing effective support in tax closing activities regarding ICMS, ICMS-ST, and submission of ancillary obligations ("obrigações acessórias") such as CIAP, Gia, Sped-Fiscal, Gis, EC, Inventory, Bloco K, EFD Contribuições, among others;
  2. Controlling tax credit balances to be offset (accumulated balance), as well as the control of PERDCOMPS;
  3. Responsible for coordinating and, when required, performing tax compliance activities, ensuring adherence to company deadlines and internal controls;
  4. Work with other stakeholders, including Accounting, to prepare calculation records, reconcile tax returns, and ensure accuracy;
  5. Active participation in company projects, resolving doubts and proposing tax paths and solutions.

It is a plus for the position to:
  1. Prepare monthly / periodic indirect tax filings for Amazon and related subsidiaries, in LATAM and Caribbean region, including but not limited to VAT, Turnover Taxes, ICA tax, and other similar taxes;
  2. Develop and implement process improvements across LATAM and Caribbean Indirect Tax compliance;
  3. Prepare basic reconciliation of transaction tax general ledger accounts.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and hires qualified individuals regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age or disability.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department
- +5 years of relevant tax experience in a corporate environment, public accounting firm or major law firm.
- Significant experience in Brazil (ICMS, ICMS ST) and international taxation concepts. Also, it is a plus to have an understanding of or practical experience related to digital, cloud, and marketplace businesses.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex tax laws in a business setting, both in Portuguese and English.
- Proficiency in English, including the ability to communicate, participate in daily video conferences, write, and understand emails. Spanish proficiency is a plus for the position.
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel is required (you'll be tested on your Excel skills)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of maintaining and operating transaction tax calculation software (e.g. Vertex) experience

Buscamos pessoas que desejam se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor aos nossos clientes. Aqui, valorizamos a equipe e o aprendizado contínuo.

Como consultor estratégico que atende ao Atacado, especialmente as áreas de Global Markets & Treasure, você garantirá o uso crescente de dados analíticos pelo negócio, gerando valor direto (receita, margem, etc).   1. Trabalhar diretamente com as áreas de negócio para implantar a cultura de Data Analytics e identificar oportunidades de valor;
  2. Realizar análises descritivas e diagnósticas de dados;
  3. Gerenciar o portfólio de iniciativas de dados e analytics;
  4. Desenvolver e implementar estratégias analíticas que apoiem as decisões;
  5. Utilizar ferramentas e técnicas avançadas de análise para resolver problemas complexos;
  6. Modernizar data-products para arquitetura Data Mesh, otimizando processos na AWS.

Requisitos essenciais:

  • Conhecimento em produtos financeiros: mercados de capitais, renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, câmbio, criptomoedas, etc.;
  • Fundamentos de Ciência de Dados para análise e discussão de premissas.

Diferenciais:

  • Programação em Python e SQL;
  • Experiência com AWS: Athena, Glue, Quicksight;
  • Conhecimentos avançados de estatística;
  • Matemática financeira;
  • Construção de agentes com IA Generativa.

description:
Job description

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA COORDENADOR CURSO II DE FISIOTERAPIA NA ESTÁCIO.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.


Main responsibilities

Os principais desafios como Pessoa Coordenador de Curso II de Fisioterapia são:

  1. Ajudar os nossos alunos em suas metas, por meio de uma boa relação, fazendo-os perceber que devem procurá-lo sempre que for preciso para resolver problemas referentes ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com os docentes, ou demais pedidos e demandas que venham a surgir, colaborando para que nossos alunos possam atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a solidificação da nossa marca;
  2. Trabalhar em equipe com os professores, com empenho e foco, visando a uma contínua melhora no processo de ensino, proporcionando aos professores toda a orientação necessária para que possam cumprir as metas e os prazos acadêmicos, estimulando-os a participar dos programas de capacitação da instituição, proporcionando-lhes um diferencial, que será percebido por nossos alunos, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a melhoria constante da qualidade acadêmica. Deverá, ainda, realizar, em parceria com o Coordenador Acadêmico de Curso, a contratação e demissões de professores, avaliação do desempenho, dando feedback ao professor com franqueza suficiente para auxiliá-lo no seu desenvolvimento profissional;
  3. Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos dos processos acadêmicos, como lançamento de oferta de disciplinas no portal, atividades dos programas de experiências, entrega de documentação do estágio e trabalho de conclusão de curso. Deve, também, supervisionar as atividades de pesquisa, se existirem, assim como as atividades de nivelamento;
  4. Trabalhar em equipe com os órgãos de assessoramento para elaborar ou atualizar o Projeto Pedagógico do Curso, construindo um projeto de qualidade, para garantir aos nossos alunos a melhor qualidade de ensino;
  5. Receber as comissões do MEC para o processo de autorização, reconhecimento e renovações, buscando conquistar as melhores médias nesses processos. Será, também, o responsável por fornecer informações para preenchimento dos formulários de avaliação do MEC e do Censo Escolar do INEP.

Requirements and skills

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Requisito A – Bacharelado em Fisioterapia.
  • Requisito B – Mestre em Fisioterapia ou áreas afins.
  • Requisito C - Capacidade de comunicação, noções sobre gestão de pessoas e processos, relacionamento com o aluno, adaptação e flexibilidade, além de atualização e domínio de conhecimentos teóricos e práticos referentes ao ensino superior.
  • Requisito D – Ter registro no conselho de Classe ativo e regular.

Additional information

Local de Trabalho: Estácio Jatiúca

Horário de Jornada: 100h (20h semanais)

Na ESTÁCIO você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pai, mãe e irmãos (as). Permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família, com o colaborador responsável pela coparticipação;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional, para cuidar da sua saúde bucal;
  • Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;
  • Gympass para opções flexíveis de academias;
  • Bem-estar e clube de vantagens com programa dedicado e vantagens exclusivas;
  • Dresscode flexível para promover a nossa diversidade;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Universidade Corporativa no nosso portal exclusivo, Educare;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento , hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido para todos os escritórios corporativos da companhia.

Trabalho remoto (home office) estendido para as mães e pais recém-chegados da licença maternidade e paternidade por até 3 meses, de acordo com a função desenvolvida.

Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e, por isso, valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

Mais inclusão: essa vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência.

DIVERSIDADE: A ESTÁCIO valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós, por isso pedimos para que não deixe de responder.

Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Hoje, atuamos diariamente para transformar e descomplicar a gestão pública através do que há de melhor na tecnologia, com uma solução única e inteligente para gestão das cidades, seja na Contabilidade, na Saúde, na Educação, ou em mais de uma dezena de áreas.

A IPM é formada por mais de 600 pessoas apaixonadas pela inovação e transformação digital das cidades. Somos movidos por grandes desafios e pelo nosso impacto, e temos um sonho maior ainda: transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas através do melhor da tecnologia.

Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Nos últimos anos, conquistamos diversos prêmios e certificações da consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW). Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos como um dos 5 melhores times de RH do Brasil; em 2023, figuramos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar pela segunda vez no ranking Mulher e pela primeira vez no ranking LGBTI+; e em 2024, recebemos pela 5ª vez consecutiva a certificação de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar. Além disso, em 2024, alcançamos o 1º lugar nacional no Prêmio Connected Smart Cities, sendo premiados pela melhor solução para cidades inteligentes no Brasil.

Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer.

title: Procurement Data Analyst II
description:
Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

Our Procurement team

Our purpose is to support, influence and challenge Nubank business decisions by delivering value to the end-to-end sourcing processes through long-term & sustainable partnerships, all executed with efficient, agile and innovative technologies.

The Procurement team's BHAG (Big Hairy Audacious Goal) is to be the best and least bureaucratic Procurement area in the technology segment by promoting cost efficiency through strategic long-term & sustainable partnerships with the highest skilled, diverse and engaged team.

You will be responsible for

  • Lead the creation and establishment of a comprehensive Procurement KPI tracking framework.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for process and efficiency improvements through data analysis and Procurement/BI tools.
  • Contribute to financial and Procurement data reporting, ensuring the delivery of reliable and timely information for various stakeholders.
  • Engage with stakeholders (such as Finance, FP&A, Engineering, Risk and other teams) across the organization to map data sources and ensure accurate data representation.
  • Develop and maintain datasets in BI and Data tools, enabling scalable data manipulation and analysis.
  • Design and implement dashboards to provide actionable insights and support decision-making for the Procurement team.
  • Utilize SQL and other programming languages (e.g., Python) to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets for optimized financial and procurement strategies.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Scala and/or Python for data analysis and experience with data visualization tools
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams as well as practical knowledge on documentation techniques, and project management tools.
  • Experience with financial technologies and a strong passion for business, economy, finance, and technology.
  • Understanding of financial statements and accounting data structure.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment.
  • Familiarity with sourcing and procurement processes is a plus.
  • Language: Advanced proficiency in English; Spanish is a beneficial addition.
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Work-from-home Allowance
  • 30 days of paid vacation

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or two weeks of remote work, one will be at the office.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seeks to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represents a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

title: Cloud Platform Support Database Engineer
description:
Product Development and Operations / Full time / Hybrid

Guidewire is looking for a proactive and solution-driven Cloud Platform Support Database Engineer to join our dynamic Global Support team. The Engineer will work collaboratively within the Product Development Operations (PDO) team, serving our customers in both Guidewire Cloud and on-premise environments. This role requires a keen understanding of our platform, backed by the continuous learning provided by Guidewire Education, Product Development, and Site Reliability Engineering teams. You will be learning new and exciting AWS technologies as we continue our journey on the cloud. In addition, you will work on multiple database platforms and utilize your skills in performance tuning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will be part of the Product Development Operations (PDO) organization working in a hybrid environment that delivers 24x7 service to customers who are using our software on the Guidewire Cloud Platform.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  1. Function as a primary contact to review, investigate, and promptly fulfill Customer requests and resolve incidents in adherence to team standards, thereby ensuring we meet and exceed customer satisfaction.
  2. Provide support for the Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server and Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL) production and non-production databases.
  3. Document and maintain technical articles, including troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, and runbooks, in order to meet objectives for customer request fulfillment and issue resolution.
  4. Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of our database, platform and applications through company-sponsored training and experience.
  5. Job activities include setup (provisioning), configuration, monitoring and production support of platform and database environments on EC2 and RDS/Aurora platforms.
  6. Collaborate with the development and support teams, develop and foster strong relationships with customers and stakeholders, and act as a trusted advisor and technical point of contact.
  7. Strong eye for product and process improvements, collaborating with other departments within the company, following the escalation path if needed.
  8. Contribute to an environment that encourages information sharing, team-based mindset, cross-training, and an absolute focus on doing what is best for the customer.

Required skills and experience:

  1. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science (or a related STEM field), or related experience.
  2. 3+ years of experience working with and troubleshooting Oracle, MySQL, MSSQL or other database technologies. Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL is a plus.
  3. Working knowledge of one or more database high availability technologies and database data replication tools is an advantage.
  4. Unix/Linux general administration skills and/or python/powershell scripting is a distinct advantage.
  5. Experience in working with AWS services, such as EC2, S3, RDS, and (Kubernetes) ECS/EKS, to deploy and manage Java applications in a cloud environment is a plus.
  6. Experience solving issues with software code and reporting progress; preference for experience with a commercial customer incident tracking tool or CRM like Salesforce.
  7. Experience using a software defect tracking system such as JIRA preferred.
  8. Skills to read and interpret application server log files.
  9. 3+ years’ experience working directly with customers or key internal partners; preference for support for a B2B software company.
  10. Outstanding analytical and troubleshooting skills; with great attention to detail, ability to think critically and display an aptitude for problem-solving.
  11. We provide 24x7 support and the job may require working shifts outside of normal business hours and weekend shifts.
  12. Read, write, and speak fluent English. Score bonus points if you have skills in another language such as French or Spanish.

Personal Qualities and Soft skills

  1. You enjoy teaching and being a mentor to others.
  2. Good communication and presentation skills with an ability to explain complex technical concepts to a varied audience.
  3. Display a strong work ethic and do whatever it takes to get the job done.
  4. A highly positive can-do attitude, thrives in a team-oriented environment, values diversity, and actively contributes to team goals.
  5. Demonstrates strong follow-through and consistently keep commitments to customers and employees.
  6. Self motivated, and ability to manage multiple tasks with different deadlines.

Bonus

  1. Company pension contributions.
  2. Fully funded medical insurance for you and your family.
  3. Annual Wellness Reimbursement.
  4. 26 annual leave days.
  5. 16 weeks paid maternity and paternity leave.
  6. 3 paid days volunteering in the community.

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of Program Manager for S&OP team to keep delighting our customers by fulfilling products from Amazon and our Selling Partners at the fastest possible speed, on-time and at the lowest possible cost. Partner with the best

As an Aeroderivative Turbine Mechanical Field Service Engineer, you will be the first point of contact for our global customers on-site. You will be responsible for leading activities, people, and ensuring HSE compliance to a high standard. Your work will include the installation, maintenance, and repair of Aeroderivative Turbines, including borescope inspections, blade work, combustion/hot section replacements, engine swaps, and other maintenance tasks. You will have opportunities to develop your product knowledge and technical skills in a dynamic, innovative environment.

As Mechanical Field Service Engineer , your responsibilities will include:

  • Providing technical direction for site activities to internal teams and skilled labor to ensure safety, compliance, and quality.
  • Performing mechanical and hydraulic maintenance, repair, or replacement of parts as directed.
  • Using hand tools and small power tools to conduct general maintenance of Aeroderivative Gas Turbines.
  • Executing on-site job duties, including subcontractor coordination and communication with customers and internal teams.
  • Troubleshooting complex mechanical and hydraulic issues on turbines.
  • Overseeing overhaul, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Aeroderivative products at customer sites.
  • Leading customer and contractor meetings to share updates and advise on technical solutions.
  • Ensuring internal training, compliance, and quality documentation are maintained according to standards.
  • Carrying out all activities safely, following environmental health & safety (EHS) guidelines and procedures.

Fuel your passion

To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a technical qualification in Mechanics.
  • An active CREA or CFT certification.
  • Previous experience as a mechanical technician on aircraft engines, aero-derivative engines, or similar turbines.
  • Good mechanical/technical and communication skills.
  • Knowledge of installation and maintenance of rotating equipment, bolting, hydraulic bolting, flange management, small bore piping.
  • Experience with gas turbines is advantageous.
  • Experience working in energy or oil and gas environments.
  • A customer service mindset and experience leading clients through technical decisions.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively.
  • Deep awareness of HSE compliance and risks.
  • Self-motivation, decision-making skills, and innovative thinking.

title: GeoTechnical Engineer - Senior Level
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for a Geotechnical Engineer to join our Sao Paulo office. As part of the Geotechnical Group, the Geotechnical Engineer assesses and analyzes the ground on which wharves, quays, buildings and other structures will be constructed/operated; examine the soil, checks the flow of underground water, and conducts other tests to ensure the stability of an area before construction begins. Development of structural/ geotechnical projects of foundations and retaining structures.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare specifications, interpret field test data (SPT, sCPT, FVST, DMT) and estimate soil engineering properties for foundation design and soil-structure interaction (SSI)
  • Recommend and monitor lab tests on items in a laboratory. Interpret results, analyze soil properties, note any contamination or other issues, and produce reports about their findings for project managers
  • Perform construction site inspections and prepare inspection reports
  • Perform geostructural analysis and design of waterfront structures, including bulkheads, retaining walls, deep foundations, and flood control structures
  • Design wall structural components, including wales, tie rods, tiebacks, cap beams, etc., comprising local and global soil stability
  • Design of buried structures
  • Design and preparation of construction drawings and contract documents
  • Study safety quality standards for different projects and ensure that each project adheres to these standards. Inspects foundations, observing drilling activities, and reviewing work plans as some ways geotechnical engineers ensure adherence to these standards
  • Present possible project risks, evaluate seismic activities geotechnical effects, make recommendations for foundations and excavation activities, and summarize the progress of individual projects
  • Resolve design problems that may include performing field investigation or inspections, detailed design work, and detailed checking of design computations done by others, or general coordination of specific design aspects into a project
  • Manage and lead multidisciplinary projects, coordinating local and international professionals and subcontractors
  • Manage internal and external client's needs and expectations
  • Perform quality assurance reviews and adhere to Moffatt & Nichol Quality Management System
  • Lead, mentor, and assist engineers and designers in developing final design plans
  • Perform office-based construction administration including review of shop drawings and technical submittals
  • Preparation of techno-commercial proposals for the services offered by Moffatt & Nichol

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or relevant experience
  • M.Sc. degree in geotechnical engineering
  • Fluency in English (Essential)
  • 15+ years of experience
  • Professional Engineer licensure in Brazil CREA
  • Experience and proficiency with the following or equivalent geotechnical software package categories:
  • Lateral pile analysis (i.e., LPile, AllPile)
  • Axial pile/drilled shaft analysis (i.e., APile, AllPile, Driven, Shaft)
  • Pile group analysis (i.e., Group, AllPile)
  • Slope stability (i.e., Slope, Slide)
  • Excavation support (i.e., DeepEX, WALLAP, Support-IT, CT Shoring Suite)
  • Finite element analysis (i.e., Plaxis)
  • Settlement (i.e., Settle3, FoSSA, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of ABNT Standards, ACI, AISC, AASHTO, IBC, NDS, and other design codes
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and AutoCAD. Experience in Civil3D a plus
  • Experience with structural analysis software (SAP, STAAD) a plus
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Working Conditions:

Majority of work is office based. Some site visits may be required which may necessitate navigating unpaved or natural terrain while carrying equipment.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You have experience programming in Python and Go
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Product owner v saman co
description:
Venha se juntar com a gente na V4 Company!

Sobre o ambiente de trabalho:

Somos guiados por atitudes claras e transparentes em nossa rotina, que nos permitem fazer o máximo para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos de modo colaborativo, o que significa que confiamos nas pessoas que estão do nosso lado.

Aqui ninguém é empregado de ninguém. O ambiente é o mais horizontal possível, possibilitando a sua autonomia para tomar as melhores decisões para as atividades pelas quais você é responsável. Não espere pelos outros aquilo que você pode fazer por si mesmo.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Definir a Visão do Produto: Colaborar com stakeholders para desenvolver e comunicar uma visão clara e inspiradora do produto.
  • Gerenciar o Backlog do Produto: Criar, refinar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo que ele reflita as necessidades do mercado e os objetivos estratégicos.
  • Maximizar o Valor do Produto: Trabalhar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir que cada sprint entregue o máximo valor possível aos usuários e ao negócio.
  • Representar o Usuário: Ser a voz do usuário, entendendo suas necessidades e garantindo que o produto as atenda de forma eficaz.
  • Coordenar Lançamentos: Planejar e coordenar lançamentos de novas funcionalidades e versões do produto.
  • Monitorar o Desempenho: Acompanhar métricas-chave de desempenho do produto e utilizar os dados para tomar decisões informadas sobre o desenvolvimento futuro.

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Experiência: Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em função similar, com histórico de entrega de produtos de sucesso.
  • Conhecimento em Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento profundo de metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar efetivamente com equipes técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Orientação a Resultados: Forte orientação a resultados, com capacidade de definir metas claras e alcançá-las.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Habilidade de analisar dados e tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.
  • Empatia: Capacidade de se colocar no lugar do usuário e entender suas necessidades e motivações.

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Certificação: Certificação em Product Owner ou Scrum.
  • Experiência em Indústria específica: Experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos na indústria relevante.
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas específicas: Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de produtos, como Jira ou Trello.

O que mais oferecemos:

  • Ambiente vibrante, cheio de pessoas com o propósito de crescer;
  • Foco em metas, não em horários;
  • Gestão meritocrática, através de Objetivos Chave de Resultados (OKRs);
  • Possibilidade de sociedade baseada no desempenho e alinhamento cultural com o negócio.

Sobre a empresa:

Há 11 anos, lideramos o caminho no Marketing Digital, sempre em busca de inovação, nos tornando a maior assessoria de marketing digital do país.

Nosso foco é na geração de vendas e na transformação da realidade de milhares de empreendedores, dentro e fora do Brasil.

Existimos para vender o seu produto, vender mais vezes, vender para mais pessoas e vender pelo maior valor.

Estruturados em um sistema de franquias, temos mais de 250 escritórios no Brasil, mais de 6.000 clientes ativos e reunimos mais de 3.500 profissionais e mais de 300 sócios, entre Matriz e Franqueados.

Nossa jornada continua, queremos elevar a V4 Company a novos patamares, e sabemos que isso só acontece com profissionais excepcionais ao nosso lado.

  • Desenvolver habilidades avançadas em automação utilizando Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Terraform ou similares. Escrever scripts complexos e criar pipelines automatizados para implantação e gerenciamento de infraestrutura;

Requisitos:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada;
  • Conhecimento em scripts e automação (Python, Bash, etc.);
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation);
  • Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk);
  • CI/CD avançado (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.);

Senior/ Staff Technical Product Manager (Platform Team)

About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

Nubank’s continued success hinges on our Platform Product Managers, who play a crucial role in recognizing and solving important customer problems at scale. This role is vital as it synthesizes our broader business strategy with the needs of development teams across the company. By building products that create leverage for our business, these managers simplify and scale capabilities to unlock potential and mitigate risks. Their work impacts our core cloud architecture, data infrastructure, finance, security platforms, customer service tools, and other internal products. They own the goal of equipping Nubank to meet evolving customer needs for decades.

You will be responsible for

  • Defining, prioritizing, and communicating both short and long-term product goals.
  • Developing a deep understanding of users and stakeholders through research, data analysis, and interviews.
  • Specifying and refining product requirements from conception to launch, collaborating closely with engineering and, if needed, design, data science, credit, and finance teams.
  • Staying updated on complex areas like cloud services and information security to guide the team.
  • Acting as an evangelist, ensuring clear communication between the team and stakeholders to bridge understanding gaps.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Experience working with software products as a Product Manager or a similar role.
  • Robust experience managing the entire product life-cycle for successful tech products.
  • A strong desire to discover and fulfill user needs.
  • Confidence in working with numbers and data-driven decision-making.
  • The ability to build strong relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • An aptitude for turning incomplete or conflicting information into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with proficiency in presentation.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A deep willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • A good understanding of the software development lifecycle.

Benefits

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every two to three months, one week will be at the office.

description:
Technical Program Manager, LATAM Integration Team

At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. Therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’.
Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. They act as ambassadors of this agenda and will support you from Day 1. Remember, at Amazon, ‘It’s always Day 1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities, to be launched in 2022.

Are you someone that can make a huge impact on Amazon's ability to drive our business growth? Are you equally comfortable digging into business and technical requirements as drilling into metrics development? Then this is the position for you.
We are looking for Technical Account Managers to own and implement a roadmap of new strategic Amazon Initiatives with our Integrators in Brazil (Marketplace Hubs). You will be responsible for building relationships, providing technical support, and engaging our partner’s development teams to implement, maintain, and grow their integrations to Amazon’s marketplace.
The Technical Account Manager must be able to balance Amazon's objectives with the needs of sellers while driving the integration process through our MWS APIs and SP-APIs. This position will require a combination of technical skills (to provide support on development and testing) and relationship skills (to negotiate and engage our partners to deliver within agreed deadlines). Additionally, the Technical Account Manager will analyze pain points, metrics, and seller experience to address improvement opportunities.
In this role, you will be required to understand our integration APIs (Amazon Marketplace Web Service - MWS and SP-APIs), which is an integrated web service that helps sellers programmatically exchange on listings, orders, payments, reports, and more.

Job functions include:

  1. Be responsible for a group of partners and manage the pipeline of projects.
  2. Daily/weekly contact with their teams via phone and email and also make recurrent visits.
  3. Provide technical support to the development teams on documentation, best practices, example codes, troubleshooting, and testing.
  4. Keep external and internal teams communicated about key project issues and actively work with responsible teams on identifying and solving paths to green.
  5. Understand seller API documentation and interact with their teams to deeply understand our APIs, follow guidelines, and/or ask for support when complex problems are found.
  6. Provide 2nd level support for complex cases when necessary.
  7. Be a technical consulting expert to the Product Manager on evaluating the best solution, estimating efforts, and defining the product roadmap.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Daily/weekly contact with their teams via phone and email and also make recurrent visits.
  2. Provide technical support to the development teams on documentation, best practices, example codes, troubleshooting, and testing.
  3. Keep external and internal teams communicated about key project issues and actively work with responsible teams on identifying and solving paths to green.
  4. Understand seller API documentation and interact with their teams to deeply understand our APIs, follow guidelines, and/or ask for support when complex problems are found.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Be a technical consulting expert to the Product Manager on evaluating the best solution, estimating efforts, and defining the product roadmap.

Como Analista Fiscal você desempenhará um papel vital na análise e otimização de processos fiscais e procedimentos, identificando riscos tributários associados às operações fiscais. We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$57 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #248 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit , and read about the latest news via our StoryHub .

Description and Requirements

Lenovo is launching a new Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) digital business in Brazil, focused on driving direct sales of server, storage, and infrastructure products through Lenovo.com.br. As the ISG Brazil eCommerce Program Manager , you will lead the end-to-end go-to-market strategy and business operations for this critical initiative, with a strong focus on accelerating growth in Brazil’s B2B market.

This is a highly strategic and cross-functional role requiring deep ownership of ISG eCommerce processes. You will work closely with Brazil’s ISG 4P and Sales teams, as well as Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization, to deliver on revenue targets, shape the customer experience, and drive digital transformation within the ISG business.

You will own Brazil’s ISG eCommerce 4P strategy across Product, Price, Place, and Promotion, and be responsible for launching and managing performance marketing programs to generate leads, influence pipeline, and convert web traffic into sales. This is a unique opportunity to help build a business from the ground up and directly impact Lenovo’s global growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

4P Strategy Ownership (Brazil ISG eCommerce)

  • Product: Define the ideal ISG eCommerce product portfolio (servers, storage, and options) for Lenovo.com in Brazil, in close collaboration with local 4P and global product and category teams.
  • Pricing: Lead Brazil-specific web pricing strategy, including promotions, deal structures, and competitive price factor value (PFV) benchmarking, in coordination with ISG Pricing and eCommerce operations.
  • Place: Position Lenovo.com.br as a key digital touchpoint for B2B ISG sales in Brazil, while supporting an integrated, omnichannel go-to-market approach in collaboration with channel partners.
  • Promotion: Develop and execute localized digital marketing demand generation campaigns aligned with ISG sales priorities, leveraging paid media, email, and account-based marketing.

Program Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead Brazil’s ISG Web go-to-market planning, forecasting, and campaign execution in alignment with Sales, ISG 4P, Supply Chain, Channel/Reseller, and eCommerce teams.
  • Partner with Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization (site operations, merchandising, UX, BT/IT, and pricing operations) to deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Lenovo.com.br
  • Own and manage key business KPIs, including overall sales and profit contribution, web traffic, conversion rates, leads, ROAS and generated pipeline.

Market Activation & Reporting

  • Represent the Brazil ISG Web business in global strategy discussions and regular business reviews, ensuring alignment with broader ISG and eCommerce goals.
  • Serve as the local subject matter expert, surfacing market-specific needs, blockers, and growth opportunities to influence global strategy and investment planning.
  • Collaborate with Lenovo’s appointed digital agency to plan, execute, and optimize demand generation campaigns across SEM, paid social, and programmatic channels — ensuring media budgets are aligned to campaign goals and delivering measurable results.
  • Lead the creative briefing process, audience targeting strategy, localization requirements, and campaign calendar in collaboration with the agency and global marketing teams.
  • Monitor campaign performance, supporting continuous optimization through A/B testing, segmentation, and funnel analysis.
  • Provide ongoing reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations using marketing automation tools (e.g., BlueCore), web analytics, and Microsoft Dynamics.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of experience in B2B marketing, product/portfolio management, or digital program leadership.
  • Proven track record of launching or scaling digital marketing and demand generation programs in Brazil or LATAM.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s B2B and IT infrastructure landscape.
  • Experience collaborating across functions such as Sales, Product Management, Pricing, and eCommerce.
  • Familiarity with servers, storage, or other data center infrastructure solutions is required.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and proficient in English.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment with distributed teams.

Why Join Lenovo?

  • Collaborate with global leaders across marketing, sales, and digital commerce.
  • Competitive salary, performance incentives, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Join a culture that values innovation, inclusion, and agility.

description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talentedSenior DevSecOps / Cloud Security Engineer to join our Technology Department, with a focus on strengthening and automating our security posture across cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

We are open to hiring this role inLisbon, Portugal , orSão Paulo, Brazil.

As a DevSecOps /Cloud Security Engineer, you will be responsible for embedding security into every stage of our infrastructure lifecycle, from design to deployment. You will lead the implementation of cloud-native security controls in AWS, harden Kubernetes environments, and drive best practices across CI/CD pipelines. Your role includes continuous vulnerability management, network protection, monitoring for threats, and working with development, DevOps and IP teams to ensure secure-by-default practices. You’ll also proactively identify risks, secure network perimeters, and automate remediation wherever possible.

A new hire in Sao Paulo would spend their first week in Lisbon/Berlin for onboarding.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls in AWS multi-account environments
  • Lead Kubernetes security architecture, including PodSecurity, RBAC, and network policies
  • Enforcezero trust network architecture and secure segmentation across cloud and hybrid environments
  • Integrate security automation into CI/CD pipelines (image scanning, SAST, IaC analysis)
  • Deploy and manage CrowdStrike, Tenable, and similar endpoint and vulnerability management tools
  • Continuously monitor infrastructure for vulnerabilities, threats, and misconfigurations
  • Enforce least privilege IAM policies and secure secrets management
  • Conduct regular audits, penetration testing, and hardening of cloud workloads and host systems
  • Conductnetwork traffic inspection using tools like VPC Flow Logs, packet capture, or NetFlow
  • Collaborate with DevOps and IP teams on security-as-code principles
  • Maintain compliance with internal policies and external standards (e.g. CIS, NIST, ISO 27001)
  • Tune and respond to alerts from WAF, IDS/IPS, and SIEM systems
  • Document security controls, incident response playbooks, and operational runbooks
  • Champion a security-first culture through collaboration, training, and awareness

Minimum Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years in DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Infrastructure Security roles
  • Strong expertise in AWS security services (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Config, Security Hub, etc.)
  • In-depth understanding ofnetwork security principles (firewalls, routing, segmentation, VPNs, IPsec, etc.)
  • Proven hands-on experience with Kubernetes security (RBAC, NetworkPolicies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Admission Controllers)
  • Experience operating CrowdStrike Falcon and Tenable Nessus / Tenable.io
  • Experience with WAFs, DDoS protection,NIDS/NIPS, and threat intelligence integrations
  • Comfortable withpacket inspection, flow analysis, and traffic monitoring (tcpdump, Wireshark, Suricata, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt) and configuration management (Ansible, Packer)
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Go, or Bash) for automation and tooling
  • Solid understanding of Linux security hardening and secure cloud networking
  • Familiarity with service mesh security in Istio or similar
  • Experience with GitOps workflows using tools like Argo CD or Flux
  • Understanding of vulnerability management, secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), and security controls for containers
  • Exposure to compliance frameworks like ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST, PCI-DSS is a plus
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Security Specialty, CKS, OSCP, or CISSP is a plus
  • Experience with multi-cloud security (Azure/GCP)
  • Background in ethical hacking, bug bounty programs, or red teaming
  • Familiarity with tools like Falco, Sysdig, Trivy, or eBPF-based runtime security tools

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: IT Engineer- LatAm
description:
Our People & Talent department at Sporty is the beating heart of our operation. Working with us is challenging and rewarding; we offer great opportunities for good team fits. We aim to offer real value and benefit to our People and the Company. A proactive, positive working attitude and solutions-driven mindset is essential to work in this lean and vital area of our organisation.

Who We Are

Sporty Group is a consumer internet and technology business with an unrivalled sports media, gaming, social and fintech platform which serves millions of daily active users across the globe via technology and operations hubs across more than 10 countries and 3 continents.

The recipe for our success is to discover intelligent and energetic people, who are passionate about our products and serving our users, and attract and retain them with a dynamic and flexible work life which empowers them to create value and rewards them generously based upon their contribution.

Candidate Profile

We are seeking an experienced IT Engineer to take care of our IT needs and provide awesome support to our employees. This is an opportunity to flex your technical muscles daily by gaining exposure to a variety of IT systems, cloud services, and cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced and exciting industry. You will also have the chance to expand your domain knowledge into global IT and security.

Responsibilities

  1. Provide technical assistance, advice, and training to users, resolve issues at the tier one level, and escalate issues to the appropriate escalation team.
  2. Install, configure, and provision computer hardware, software, and peripherals.
  3. Oversee deployment and maintenance of IT systems, ensuring optimal and reliable operations.
  4. Manage and maintain company IT assets and systemic inventory.
  5. Be a liaison for compliance with statutory requirements imposed by the Data Protection Act.
  6. Develop the completion of data protection documentation using the Data Capability Assurance framework.
  7. Empower and support business groups demonstrating their compliance during audits.
  8. Administer corporate telecom/network systems, including topology, configuration, design, and security.
  9. Research and recommend technologies and best practices approaches for our environment.
  10. Assist with Global IT and Security projects.
  11. Maintain essential IT operations, including operating systems, security tools, VPN gateways, email systems, laptops, desktops, software, and hardware.
  12. Procure and manage devices, including laptops and other IT assets.
  13. Handle IT asset allocations at the time of joining and exits, both virtually and in-person.
  14. Create, manage, and deactivate email IDs, user accounts, Office Automation, and Security tools.
  15. Monitor system performance and troubleshoot hardware and software issues.
  16. Lead IT helpdesk to support employees, ensuring all desktop applications, workstations, and related equipment problems are resolved promptly with limited disruptions.
  17. Maintain, repair, and upgrade systems and processes, including hardware and software programs.

Skills and Qualification Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Administration, or a closely related field.
  2. 5+ years of relevant experience in IT systems, network administration, and related technologies.
  3. Proficiency with firewalls, SDN, and network routing.
  4. Advanced knowledge of network technology and security principles.
  5. Advanced knowledge of SSO, MDM, and system provisioning in Windows, Mac, and Linux systems.
  6. Advanced knowledge in managing cloud IT services and security.
  7. Understanding and knowledge of the Data Protection Acts.
  8. Articulate complex data law requirements in a clear and user-friendly way/format.
  9. Strong knowledge of systems and networking, and the ability to effectively use computerized solutions.
  10. Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems.
  11. Solid knowledge of best practices in IT administration, system vulnerabilities, and security.
  12. Ability to think critically, analyze root causes, diagnose problems, and provide solutions.
  13. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  14. Ability to work independently and take end-to-end accountability for employee IT issues.
  15. Should be flexible with work from office (Sao Paulo, Brazil).

Benefits

  1. Performance-based quarterly bonus.
  2. Referral bonus.
  3. IT Asset provided.
  4. 28 days paid annual leave.
  5. Annual company retreat.
  6. Highly talented, dependable co-workers in a global, multicultural organization.
  7. Our teams are small enough for you to be impactful.
  8. Our business is globally established and successful, offering stability and security to our Team Members.

Our Mission

Our mission is to be an everyday entertainment platform for everyone.

Our Operating Principles

  1. Create Value for Users.
  2. Act in the Long-Term Interests of Sporty.
  3. Focus on Product Improvements & Innovation.
  4. Be Responsible.
  5. Preserve Integrity & Honesty.
  6. Respect Confidentiality & Privacy.
  7. Ensure Stability, Security & Scalability.
  8. Work Hard with Passion & Pride.

Interview Process

  1. 30 min Aptitude Test.
  2. Remote video screening with our Talent Acquisition Team.
  3. Remote 90 min video interview loop with 3 x Team Members (30 mins each).
  4. 24-72 hour feedback loops throughout the process.

Working at Sporty

The top-down mentality at Sporty is high performance-based, meaning we trust you to do your job with an emphasis on support to help you achieve, grow and de-block any issues when they're in your way. Generally, employees can choose their own hours, as long as they are collaborating and doing stand-ups etc. The emphasis is really on results.

As we are a highly structured and established company, we are able to offer the security and support of a global business with the allure of a startup environment. Sporty is independently managed and financed, meaning we don’t have arbitrary shareholder or VC targets to cater to.

We literally build, spend and make decisions based on the ethos of building THE best platform of its kind. We are truly a tech company to the core and take excellent care of our Team Members.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
Location: Globally remote role
The role entails
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
  • Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
  • Python software development expertise
  • Operational experience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public or private cloud management
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo! O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

  8. Advanced English proficiency for reading and interpreting technical documentation.

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
