Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'

What we are looking for in you
  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.
Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.
The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.
This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end-system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Ubuntu Core Software Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity , we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Frontend AI Engineer
description:
A fast-growing, AI-powered platform focused on revolutionizing personalized learning experiences is seeking a Frontend Engineer . This role involves building and maintaining user-facing features, ensuring the platform delivers an intuitive and seamless experience for its users. If you are passionate about frontend development and excited about contributing to an innovative AI-driven product, we encourage you to apply.

Location:
Fully-Remote (Work from Home), 9 AM - 5 PM EST

Role Overview:
We are seeking a talented and creative Frontend Engineer to help develop and maintain user-facing features using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks like React or Next.js. You will collaborate closely with designers and product managers to bring engaging, user-friendly features to life, ensuring optimal performance and accessibility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Feature Development: Develop and maintain user-facing features using TypeScript and frameworks like React or Next.js.

  • UI Component Creation: Create responsive, accessible, and visually appealing UI components aligned with design guidelines and brand aesthetics.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with designers and product managers to translate design requirements into user-friendly and functional features.

  • Optimization: Optimize frontend performance, ensuring smooth and fast load times across various devices and browsers.

  • API Integration: Integrate frontend components with backend APIs to deliver seamless user interactions and platform functionality.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Intuitive User Interface: Features are developed and maintained with a focus on providing a seamless, accessible, and visually appealing user experience.

  • Efficient Collaboration: Close cooperation with product and design teams results in effective, user-friendly feature implementation.

  • Performance Optimization: Ensuring the platform operates efficiently with minimal load times and optimal cross-device performance.

  • Seamless API Integration: Smooth and integrated user-facing components that work flawlessly with the backend, providing high-quality user interactions.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Design, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in frontend development, particularly with modern web applications.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in TypeScript and frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js.

  • Web Fundamentals: Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern web design principles (responsive design, component-based architecture).

  • State Management: Experience with state management tools like Redux or Context API.

  • Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems like Git.

Preferred Skills (Highly Advantageous):

  • Design Systems: Experience with design systems and UI/UX tools like Figma to ensure consistency across the platform.

  • Accessibility: Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and best practices for building inclusive, accessible applications.

  • Testing: Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, Cypress, or React Testing Library.

  • Internationalization: Experience with internationalization/localization (e.g., using i18next) to support a global user base.

Non-Negotiables for the Ideal Candidate:

  • Self-Starter: Highly motivated and able to take ownership of projects without needing micromanagement.

  • AI Startup Experience: Previous experience working in an AI startup or fast-paced tech environment is a must.

  • Proven Collaboration: Must have experience collaborating closely with design and product teams, translating business requirements into frontend solutions.

  • Remote Readiness: Ability to thrive in a remote-first environment, managing time effectively and communicating clearly across distributed teams.

  • Passion for Learning: Eagerness to stay updated with the latest trends in frontend technologies and AI-driven products.

Opportunity:
This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-thinking AI-driven team dedicated to enhancing personalized learning experiences. As a Frontend Engineer, you’ll help shape the future of the platform by building user-friendly, responsive, and scalable features. If you’re a self-starter with a passion for creating seamless frontend experiences, we encourage you to apply.

title: Product Owner
description:
Job description

Aqui na wBrain, não transformamos apenas organizações; evoluímos pessoas. Somos um ecossistema de profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e desafios.

Estamos à procura de pessoas como você. Futuros talentos. Mentes brilhantes e criativas. Gente que pensa fora da caixa e que tem a vontade de causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

O Product Owner (PO) é o responsável por definir a visão do produto, criar e gerenciar o backlog do produto, e garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento entregue funcionalidades de alto valor que atendam às necessidades do negócio e dos clientes. Ele atua como principal ponto de contato entre as partes interessadas (stakeholders) e a equipe de desenvolvimento, garantindo que o produto evolua de acordo com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades:

  • Visão e Estratégia do Produto:
    • Desenvolver e comunicar a visão do produto para a equipe e stakeholders.
    • Garantir que o desenvolvimento do produto esteja alinhado com os objetivos de negócios e as necessidades do mercado.
    • Manter uma visão clara e consistente do produto, e transmitir isso de forma eficaz para todos os envolvidos no projeto.
  • Gestão do Backlog:
    • Criar, priorizar e gerenciar o backlog do produto, garantindo que ele reflita as necessidades dos usuários e as prioridades de negócios.
    • Quebrar funcionalidades de alto nível em histórias de usuários detalhadas e bem definidas.
    • Refinar continuamente o backlog com base em feedbacks, novos insights e mudanças de mercado.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders:
    • Trabalhar de forma próxima com as partes interessadas (liderança de negócios, marketing, vendas e clientes) para obter requisitos e entender as necessidades do produto.
    • Traduzir o feedback dos stakeholders em histórias de usuários e requisitos claros.
    • Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre o andamento do projeto para os stakeholders, incluindo prazos de entrega, prioridades e eventuais riscos.
  • Planejamento de Sprint e Execução:
    • Colaborar com o Scrum Master/agilista e a equipe de desenvolvimento no planejamento e execução das sprints.
    • Garantir que a equipe entenda claramente as histórias de usuário e requisitos, fornecendo detalhes suficientes para o desenvolvimento.
    • Ser o ponto de contato para a equipe durante a sprint, esclarecendo dúvidas e tomando decisões rápidas quando necessário.
  • Critérios de Aceitação e Testes:
    • Definir critérios de aceitação claros para as funcionalidades e histórias de usuário.
    • Revisar e aprovar as entregas para garantir que atendem aos critérios de aceitação.
    • Realizar testes de aceitação do usuário (UAT) e coordenar com os stakeholders para garantir que o produto atenda aos padrões exigidos antes do lançamento.
  • Melhoria Contínua:
    • Acompanhar o desempenho do produto e o feedback dos usuários para realizar melhorias contínuas.
    • Identificar de forma proativa áreas de melhoria, tanto no produto quanto nos processos de desenvolvimento.
    • Trabalhar com equipes de análise de dados para medir o sucesso do produto e ajustar as estratégias conforme necessário.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades e Qualificações:

  • Boa compreensão técnica do produto e do processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência em um domínio específico (e.g., aplicativos móveis, software corporativo, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em cargos similares em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Forte entendimento das metodologias e frameworks ágeis.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais para colaborar com stakeholders em todos os níveis.
  • Pensamento analítico e capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (e.g., Jira, Trello, Slice ou similares).
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Familiaridade com a indústria ou mercado no qual a empresa atua (e.g., tecnologia, e-commerce, saúde) é um diferencial.
  • Certificação em Product Management ou Agile (por exemplo, Certified Scrum Product Owner - CSPO).
  • Experiência com plataformas ou produtos específicos (e.g., SaaS, e-commerce, produtos móveis, etc.).

Soft Skills:

  • Senso de urgência
  • Resiliência
  • Iniciativa/ Protagonismo
  • Capacidade de se adaptar e respeitar os processos e regras corporativas/globais
  • Coragem para conversas difíceis/comunicação assertiva
  • Organização
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva
  • Escuta ativa

O aumento da demanda, a dificuldade de compra e transporte, além do prazo de entrega, fizeram com que nos inspirássemos a montar uma indústria própria. Então em 2000, inauguramos nossa indústria de vidro temperado, a primeira do estado de Rondônia, com forno de têmpera vertical. Cada vez mais aquecido, o mercado exigia novos produtos e mais rapidez de entrega. Visando isso, em 2002 demos um grande passo ao adquirir um forno horizontal de tecnologia americana, que produzia vidros com mais rapidez e qualidade. Dessa forma, a Mirandex se torna a maior empresa do ramo vidraceiro da região Norte do Brasil.

  1. Planejar, organizar e supervisionar as atividades de produção, dentro das especificações e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos, visando a assegurar o cumprimento dos objetivos da empresa na área comercial.

  5. Analisar e avaliar os aspectos econômicos do processo produtivo, no tocante a mão-de-obra e quantidade de materiais consumidos, visando a identificar oportunidades ou alternativas que permitam a redução de custos.
  6. Elaborar procedimentos e determinar diretrizes para manutenção do visual da fábrica, no que se refere a limpeza, pintura, conservação etc., visando a manter o local em condições que propiciem o melhor desempenho dos funcionários e dos equipamentos.
  7. Estudar, desenvolver e/ou aperfeiçoar processos, equipamentos, ferramental etc., bem como estabelecer controles de processos, visando garantir melhor qualidade e maior produtividade. General PIC Responsibilities

  • Manage intercompany transactions and regional pricing

  • Participate in other special projects as needed

PIC Costing Senior Financial Analyst:

  • Coordinate and perform annual costing, ICP, markup setup process

  • SLOB / FAA consolidation, DOS Calculation, Net Inventory Reports

  • Partner closely with Finance Partners (BUF, PF&A, Make, Source) to have robust knowledge on the end-to-end costing variation and inventory drivers
  • Lead FAA analyses and closing activities for FAA supply chain groups
  • Lead forecast cycles - FAA/ Inventory total global support

PIC Currency Senior Financial Analyst:

  • Ensure timely preparation and in-depth analysis of the currency impacts for budget updates and actuals
  • Ensure timely preparation and submission of hedging exposures
  • Provide in-depth analysis for hedging and currency impacts
  • Manage supply chain currency exchanges and associated risks
  • Support analytics to drive cash flow and profitability

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s Degree is required in area related to Finance/ Accounting or Engineering/Business Management
  • 4-6 years of experience

Desired Qualifications

title: CONSULTOR INTELIGENCIA SUPRIMENTOS
description:
Professional Areas Procurement & Supply Chain

Louis Dreyfus Company is in the middle of a company transformation program (named BOLD) focused on back office processes starting with Finance, Procurement and integration schemes with the group front office systems. The objectives of such strategic project are to enhance steering capabilities, increase control / compliance and improve efficiency through the implementation of group wide core model processes supported by standard organization principles and a single ERP (SAP S/4Hana completed by SAP Ariba).

The procurement function is expected through the project completion, based on the implementation of a single operating model, to reinforce their ability to deliver LDC on the addressable spend (approx. $1,2bn globally) with the following value pillars:

  • Continuity: Define appropriate category strategies and drive supplier performance to reduce supply related operational risks
  • Efficiency: Improve efficiency of the purchase to invoice flow through integrated end to end processes
  • Control: Increase cost / budget control and Reduce fraud risks based on policies and continuous controls
  • Savings: Deliver cost reduction and avoidance based on category strategy, market intelligence and rigorous vendor selection process

As part of this journey which has been going on for the last years, LDC designed and built such solution core model and initiated its roll out through the deployment of in various countries such as Germany, France, Uruguay, Switzerland, Argentina and United States. Next phase of the project which is planned to last 4 years will be focused on deploying the solution to all the geographies LDC operates in to collect the expected value.

The Procurement BPO - NLT will be in charge, for North Latam region (Brazil) and within the program team and organization, of leading ‘hands on’ from a functional standpoint the deployment of ‘BOLD procurement’ (processes, systems and operating principles) and owning the procurement processes within the country (Source to Contract and Purchase to pay with underlying Master Data Management) with a constant focus on the macro project and function objectives towards value creation for the company.

Such activities shall be performed in full alignment with the core / global BOLD program team and in coordination with key country stakeholders within and outside of the procurement function (IT, Procurement Subject Matter Experts, finance / Account Payable teams, master data teams, industry teams…).

Initial focus will be given to lead analysis, identify gaps, plan strategy and oversee the project execution to guarantee a smooth transition between the current Brazil ERP (Tango) used in all Platforms to the BOLD project environment. This project is expected to last 3 years and will be followed by the implementation of the remaining Source to Contract and Purchase to Pay processes as part of the larger ERP implementation.

The success of the project is foundational for the procurement team to reach the next maturity level towards improved value creation for LDC.

As an additional context information, LDC procurement addressable scope in North Latam is worth approximately $380m spent across four main (mostly) indirect spend categories such as Industry Supplies (Chemicals, Energy, Packaging), Industry operations (spare parts, maintenance services, outsourced labors and various other services), Projects (Greenfield, Brownfield, SHE…) and G&A expenses.

Job Description

The Procurement Process Owner - North LATAM will be accountable for the realization of the expected procurement related benefits in the country across the full addressable spend and will need to maintain the focus on value creation for the company across each and every activity.

Across the various phases of the project, the role will be responsible for the following:

  • Perform the discovery phase to guarantee the right project implementation according to LDC necessities identifying the Gaps / Improvements between the current version of Tango to the new version of BOLD
  • Identify, mobilize, align and maintain the appropriate procurement stakeholders network (in/outside the country, in/outside the function, in/outside the project, in/outside the company - ie suppliers where impacted) and ensure the knowledge of such network on the project objectives, scope, content… remains at the level it needs to be,
  • Build, maintain and execute the Organization Change Management plan which shall consist of a proper impact analysis of BOLD operating model in the country on process, system and people together with proper action plan for any identified gap (where such actions can be either process modification, system development or organization adjustments)
  • Drive the functional requirements articulation to a maximal adoption of the core model (or possibly enrichment of such core model) and an adaptation to the country needs to the extent such adaptation is value driven on a case by case and really needed, either driven by legal / regulatory constraint or specific value drivers,
  • As part of the LDC group wide procurement BPOs network, contribute to the enrichment of the global core model so that such core model keeps fitting to what the company needs over the time,
  • Where system localization is needed and approved, ensure requirements are properly articulated / documented so that it can be seamlessly delivered by project ‘factories’ and any delivery is tested properly,
  • Develop, implement through initial and continuous training and manage solution Key Users across all the processes at stake (Purchase to Pay, Source to Contract and Master Data related), to support the initial project, run and continuous enhancements activities,
  • Adopt (adapt where needed) and execute the appropriate training strategy towards both key users and end users, for all types of users (requesters, approvers, receivers, buyers, AP clerks, Master Data clerks…)
  • Perform and coordinate the end-to-end solution testing, relying on the above mentioned Key Users network and feed the core teams with documented outcomes and feedback,
  • Manage adoption and project success through a set of pre-agreed KPIs and lead improvement plans as appropriate.
  • Perform hypercare after go live, ensure post go-live support is in place for any deployed countries and perform functional level 3 support activities as a member of the project team.

Experience

5 to 10 years in procurement and industrial environment, ideally with a focus on indirect spend categories, ideally across all the three procurement pillars (Sourcing, Buying operations, procurement excellence), ideally within both low and high maturity procurement organization

Proven experience in a Purchase to Pay deployment project (process / system), ideally in a leading position.

Mastering of the Source To Contract and Purchase to Pay processes and procurement organization structure

Engineering or Business Administration, ideally with a major in procurement or supply chain management

Portuguese and English are a must to have

Experience with SAP MM is a must have, Experience with an S/4Hana, SAP SRM and SAP Ariba (Sourcing, SLP and Network) are nice to have.

Technical/ Functional skills:

  • Must be able to interact efficiently within various dimensions, at various level and in various geographies of the organization (within and outside of the project team)
  • Must be the owner of such process for LDC within and outside the function at the country level and contribute in the global BPO network
  • Should be comfortable with the project phases and autonomous in a project environment
  • Must be able to define and execute the appropriate change management plan
  • Must be comfortable with how systems can efficiently support processes
  • Ability to manage comes from the ‘virtual’ teams (Subject Matters Expert and Key Users network)

Other skills and competencies:

  • Must be able to analyze a situation and then identify and evaluate possible solutions (turn complex situations into simple things to be able to make the best decision).
  • Has to be able to act collectively and collaboratively
  • Needs to be able to audit existing processes and gap with recommended
  • Has to understand fully the details in order to come up with the appropriate solutions and recommendation

Problem-solving:

A large part of the expected value from the project being driven by the ability of the overall operating model (processes, system and organization principles) to be standardized across the board, the key challenge for the Procurement Process Owner - North Latam will be to be able to maximize in the scope at stake (and contribute to enrich) such solution core model.

Interactions/ interface:

The role will require regular travels to the facilities as part of the project activities.

The Procurement Process Owner - North Latam is expected to interact:

  • With the local project steering committee
  • With other members of the core project team (which includes other business functions representatives as well as IT solutions managers)
  • With other members of the local and core procurement team
  • With third parties involved in the project and in particular the solution integrator which supports LDC in the project

Requisitos e qualificações

Para fazer a sua história acontecer aqui, precisamos que você domine esses assuntos:

  1. Formação técnica ou superior em áreas como Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Física Médica ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Experiência prévia com equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, etc.);
  3. Conhecimento em processos de manutenção e calibração de equipamentos médicos;

  5. Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar;
  6. CNH de categoria B;

Agora, se você quiser se diferenciar, é bom você ter…

  1. Conhecimento em normas regulatórias da ANVISA e demais regulamentações do setor de saúde;
  2. Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e normas internacionais;
  3. Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de equipamentos médicos ou saúde.

Informações adicionais

O que você ganha ao fazer parte da nossa história:

  1. Trabalhar em um ambiente inovador e com grande potencial de crescimento profissional;
  2. Possibilidade de atuação remota ou em diversos pontos do Brasil, com flexibilidade de horários;
  3. Participação em programas de capacitação e treinamentos contínuos;
  4. Excelente oportunidade de desenvolvimento de carreira no setor de saúde e tecnologia.

Região de atuação:

Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e saúde, deseja fazer a diferença em um setor inovador e em crescimento, cadastre-se e venha fazer parte da nossa história!

Management consulting a plus.

Nosso Jeito de ser BEL

Somos uma empresa que atua desde 1943 com excelência na fabricação , distribuição e comercialização de produtos químicos e agrícolas.

Desenvolvemos com pioneirismo reconhecido mundialmente , a extração de magnésio na forma de óxidos, hidróxidos e carbonatos, sendo utilizados em indústrias químicas, farmacêuticas, alimentícias e cosméticas.

  • Protagonismo : Exercer a liderança e se destacar pela tomada de iniciativas, assumir responsabilidades com persistência e fazer acontecer, dando o seu melhor na busca de resultados extraordinários.
  • Todos somos BEL : Estar presente no dia a dia da empresa, colocando-se no lugar do outro e entendendo o impacto que o seu trabalho causa em outras pessoas, áreas e resultados. Ser uma equipe única, praticando os valores, compartilhando as melhores práticas e celebrando as conquistas com orgulho de ser BEL.
